digest.component_or_area: workflow execution and plan-review module structure
propositions: Three files (plan_review/workflow_ops.py at 794 LOC, llm/config.py at 793 LOC, and plan_review_recovery.py) lack headroom guards despite being the files with highest module growth risk and needing the most structural defence.

An existing guard in test_gate_dispatch_seam.py asserts on a stale premise: it claims gate_dispatch.py holds three finalize_verdict call sites for justification, but Change 1484 moved those sites to plan_review/workflow_ops.py and plan_review_recovery.py, leaving zero sites in the guarded file.

Step registration via @register_step import side effects into process-global STEP_REGISTRY is undetectable by static analysis, schema validation, linter, or existing test_contracts.py, making an unregistered workflow step invisible to every layer until runtime WorkflowError on an executed path.

A guard that depends on pre-populated process-global state (STEP_REGISTRY populated by prior test imports) cannot falsify the defect it claims to catch and would be decorative unless run in subprocess isolation with clean sys.modules on first import.
